# YAPP_Box

Source: https://github.com/mrWheel/YAPP_Box
Pinned commit: f9400c419ef1dea7dc0b3607876989b4f3faa2b7
Files: unmodified YAPPgenerator_v3.scad and LICENSE from that commit.
License: MIT; copyright (c) 2022 Willem Aandewiel.

RobotForge's optional enclosure_yapp.scad export includes this actual generator
and calls YAPPgenerate(). Download the generator and LICENSE beside the wrapper.
The default standalone RobotForge enclosure uses independent basic geometry;
it is not YAPP. The alternate export uses YAPP's ridge mating design and needs
OpenSCAD/render and physical fit verification before fabrication.
